scope: data-loader runtime only; no FlightReady v2 or dataset change
observation: The batch-32 feasibility pilot showed repeated Windows worker-process startup dominating validation latency.
justification: In-process loading removes Windows spawn overhead. It does not alter sample ordering, augmentation settings, labels, image bytes, test policy, model, optimizer, or random seed.
status_of_prior_runs: All workers=2 runs are retained as feasibility evidence and excluded from primary statistics; primary conditions are executed consistently with workers=0.
